shared_elements: bird or bird-headed creature in profile
low-relief figures arranged in horizontal registers/bands
horizontal band of repeated small marks or signs
justification: Both surfaces show profile creatures (including birds/bird-headed forms) in relief organised into horizontal registers with a band of small repeated marks, which is about as generic a correspondence as relief carving allows. The differences dominate: B is a strictly heraldic composition of large hybrid winged anthropomorphic figures flanking an elaborate central plant motif, rendered with dense ornamental patterning, while A is a stack of simple, sparsely spaced schematic animal outlines (quadrupeds, a fox-like beast, a long-necked bird) with no symmetry and no human or hybrid figures.
